paite: Hadrak gam dou in TOUPA thu a kilak a, "Damaskas akhawlna mun ahi ding. Aram khopite TOUPA a ahi, Israel nam tengteng ahih bang un,
heading: Kho Kim A Namte Demna
english: A revelation. Yahweh’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward Yahweh—

paite: huan pil mah le uh agamgitpih Hamath, Tura leh Sidon tung atung ding hi.
english: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

paite: Tura kulh muanhuaitak in akilamkhia in, dangka leivui bang in vum venvon in, kongzingte buannawi bang in dangka-eng hoih in dim mahleh.
english: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA'N amah neih-le-lam alamang ding a, tuipi a ahauhsakna ahihse ding; huchi in meikuang a nekgaih ahong hi ding hi.
english: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

paite: "Ashkelon in huai amu dia, alau ding; Gaza in leng amu dia, nakpi a suknat in a-om ding; Ekron, alametna zahlakna ahi dia; Gaza a kipan kumpipa amangthang ding a, Ashkelon luah in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

paite: Huchi in Ashdod ah chi siangloute ateng ding ua, Philistiate kisaktheihna ka satkhe ding hi.
english: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

paite: Huan akam a kipan asisan ka lamang ding a, ahate kikal a kipan in akihhuainate; huchi in amah leng i Pathian a ding in khosuaksun ahi ding hi; Jebus mi bang in Judah leh Ekron ah hausa ahi ding hi.
english: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

paite: Huan sepaih pawlte ziak in akimvel in ka inn ka um ding, huchi a kuamah apaisuak uhiam akik nawnlouhna ding un; huchi in nuaisiahmi in apaltan nawnta kei ding; tu in ka mit mahmah in ka muta hi," achi hi.
english: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

paite: Aw Zion tanu, nakpi mahmah in kipak in; Aw Jerusalem tanu, kikou in; ngai in, na kumpipa kiniamkhiak in, sabiltung tung, sabiltungnou tuan ngei nailouhna tung a tuang in na kiang ah ahong hi; amah adiktat a, hotdamna anei.
heading: Messia Kumpi Chiamtehna
english: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

paite: Ephraim a kipan kangtalai leh Jerusalem a kipan sakol ka satkhe ding a, kidouna thalpeu satkhiak in a-om ding a; namte kiang ah lemna thu agen ding; huchi in agam tuipi a kipan tuipi tan, luipi a kipan lei tawpnate tan ahi ding hi.
english: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

paite: Nang tungthu ah leng, na thukhun sisan ziak in tui omlouhna kokhuk a kipan in na suangkul tangte ka sawlkheta hi.
heading: Pathian Mite Tunding Nawnna
english: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

paite: Lametna suangkul a tangte, kulh muanhuai lam ah kihei un; tuni mahmah in na tung ah azahnih in ka hon dinkik ding chih ka puang hi.
english: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

paite: Judah thalpeu bang in ka laikulta a, Ephraim thal a bawl in thalpeu ah ka bulhta hi. Aw Zion, na tapate dou ding in na tapate ka tokthou ding, Aw Grik, huchi in mihat namsau bang in, nang ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

paite: Huchi in atung ah TOUPA akimu ding a, khophia bang in athal apaikhe ding; Toupa PATHIAN in pengkul amut dia, simlam pingpei toh apaikhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord Yahweh will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N amaute ahunkhe ding a; suang sailim tangte asikden ding ua; anegai ding ua, uain bang in asisan uh adawn ding uh; noubemte bang in adim ding ua, maitam ningte bang in akawt ding uhi.
english: Yahweh of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA a Pathian un abelamhonte bang in amau ahondam ding a; lallukhu a suangmantamte bang in agam ah atang ding uhi.
english: Yahweh their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

paite: Ahi, ahoihna alian mahmah a, akilawmna athupi mahmah a; buh-le-bal in tangvalte atai ding a, uain thak in nungakte atai ding uhi.
english: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.
